```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 2.6, fig.height = 5.0, dpi = 96)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse); library(readxl); library(rstatix); library(ggtext); library(knitr)
})

PANEL <- "J"
DATA_FILE <- "data/Fig4DL_OptionA_data.xlsx"
group_levels <- c("Sal-N","Sal-Hx","LPS-N","LPS-Hx")
group_fill <- c("Sal-N"="#C6D0E2","Sal-Hx"="#7A8FA8","LPS-N"="#3A4D68","LPS-Hx"="#C8B8BC")
group_dot  <- c("Sal-N"="#4A6FA5","Sal-Hx"="#2C4A6E","LPS-N"="#0D1F38","LPS-Hx"="#A55C66")
theme_panel <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=12, color="black", angle=90, hjust=1, vjust=0.5),
        plot.title = element_textbox_simple(size=10, hjust=0.5, halign=0.5,
                                             fill="#E8E5EE", color="grey15", box.color=NA,
                                             padding = margin(3,6,3,6),
                                             margin = margin(0,0,5,0),
                                             r = unit(2,"pt"),
                                             width = grid::unit(0.7,"npc")))
p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.0001) "****" else if (p < 0.001) "***" else
  if (p < 0.01)  "**"   else if (p < 0.05) "*"   else ""
}
```

# Overview

**Figure 4J** — Purkinje-cell mitochondrial density at P45 (per-cell). Each dot = one cell. Test: Kruskal–Wallis (matches the published Prism workflow); post-hoc Dunn pairwise (Bonferroni-adjusted).

```{r load}
d <- read_excel(DATA_FILE, sheet = "all_long") |>
  filter(panel == PANEL) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group_levels))
kable(d |> count(group, name = "n_cells"),
      caption = sprintf("Per-group n at the per-cell level for Panel %s", PANEL))
```

# Kruskal–Wallis omnibus test

```{r kw}
k <- kruskal.test(value ~ group, data = d)
data.frame(test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
           statistic = signif(unname(k$statistic), 4),
           df = unname(k$parameter),
           p_value = signif(k$p.value, 4),
           signif = p_to_stars(k$p.value)) |>
  kable(caption = "Omnibus Kruskal-Wallis")
```

# Dunn pairwise post-hoc

```{r dunn}
ph <- rstatix::dunn_test(d, value ~ group, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni")
ph |> kable(caption = "Dunn pairwise (Bonferroni-adjusted)", digits = 4)
```

# Figure 4J

```{r plot, fig.width=2.6, fig.height=5.0}
sig <- ph |> filter(p.adj < 0.05) |> arrange(p.adj) |>
  mutate(label = vapply(p.adj, p_to_stars, character(1)),
         xmin  = match(group1, group_levels),
         xmax  = match(group2, group_levels))
ymax <- 1.30
ypad <- if (nrow(sig) > 0) ymax * (1 + 0.09 * (1 + nrow(sig))) else ymax * 1.05

p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = group, y = value)) +
  stat_summary(aes(fill = group), fun = mean, geom = "col",
               width = 0.35, color = "black", linewidth = 0.40, alpha = 0.60) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.14, linewidth = 0.50, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = group, color = group), shape = 21,
              width = 0.10, size = 2.0, stroke = 0.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_fill) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_dot) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.55, 0.30))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ypad), clip = "off") +
  labs(y = "Mitochondrial density", title = "J. P45 PC mitochondrial density") +
  theme_panel

if (nrow(sig) > 0) {
  sig$y <- ymax * (1.00 + 0.08 * seq_len(nrow(sig)))
  p <- p +
    geom_segment(data = sig, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = sig, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin,
                                 y = y, yend = y - ymax * 0.015),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = sig, aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax,
                                 y = y, yend = y - ymax * 0.015),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = sig, aes(x = (xmin + xmax)/2,
                              y = y + ymax * 0.04, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4, fontface = "bold")
}
p
ggsave("Fig4J.pdf", plot = p, width = 2.4, height = 5.0,
       device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave("Fig4J.png", plot = p, width = 3.0, height = 5.0, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
